additional_info.subject: Customer query
additional_info.body:
During the on-site inspection we noticed a faulted display at the charger (see attached image). Why do we not get an OCPP error message about the faulted display? How should we know about the issue without camera detection or customer complaints?
Software Version: v4.0.11-0-g0b7d164+SF-RETOPICS (PRODUCTION)
OCPP Backend Connection: Yes
